run_googletest_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception catching behavior
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_fixture_con: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_set_up_test: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and prevent test execution
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown still runs
test_unhandled_cxx_exceptions_abort_prog: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
